name: mistake-loop
description: 小学语数外错题闭环：常驻服务每日自动推进复习，学生端全纸质

scripts.check: for f in $(find src scripts test -name '*.mjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in $(find public/js -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node scripts/check-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-issue-map.mjs
